messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated latency and pod restarts in runtime-batcher pool. p95>1800ms, restarts=8 in 15m. incident=INC-2026-23124
sam (oncall): taking this. Noted spike in p95 and restart storms. Paging eng-runtime + sre.
sam (oncall): @mira @ryan please confirm whether this is batcher related or something lower-level.
mira (eng-runtime): Initial look: batcher queue length keeps climbing, some pods reporting repeated `cudaErrorMemoryAllocation` and then SIGKILL. grabbing pod logs.
ryan (sre): Host telemetry shows heavy swap activity on node-usw2-c-7 and kernel OOM notifications. Nodes also show kubelet reconnects.
toni (prodops): Customer-facing impact: PaymentCheckout and ChatAPI both show elevated 5xx; support ticket from BetaRetail about timeouts.
mira (eng-runtime): Pod log snippet from runtime-batcher-7:
```
2026-03-21T03:45:02Z batch_manager.cpp:87 INFO reserve(32) -> reserved tokens=32
2026-03-21T03:46:10Z batch_manager.cpp:231 WARN resize_attempt: desired=1024 current=256 growth_delta=+768
2026-03-21T03:46:10Z gpu_alloc.cc:54 ERROR cudaMalloc failed: out of memory (requested=1400MB)
2026-03-21T03:46:10Z launcher.cc:134 ERROR kernel launch failed -> terminating process
*** ABORTING ***
```
mira (eng-runtime): That resize delta is alarming. The resize routine is allowing large jumps when under burst. Also seeing a steady backlog of pending requests in the internal queue.
ryan (sre): Kernel logs on node show repeated `kswapd` entries and `Out of memory: Kill process` events coincident with the crashes. Looks like host memory pressure + GPU alloc failures. Could be fragmentation + large batch allocations.
sam (oncall): Short-term mitigation ideas?
toni (prodops): Can we cut the upstream load by redirecting noncritical customers? We have traffic classes; can throttle BetaRetail and non-SLA traffic.
mira (eng-runtime): Two quick options: 1) disable auto-resize so batches are fixed/limited (via RUNTIME_FLAGS) 2) enable a soft circuit-breaker: reject enqueue when queue growth rate exceeds threshold. Option 1 is fastest.
ryan (sre): Also recommend cordoning nodes showing heavy swap so they don't take new pods while we repair. I'll cordon node-usw2-c-7 and node-usw2-c-9.
sam (oncall): Toni - please prepare customer comms and apply temporary traffic class throttles. Mira - prepare config change. Ryan - cordon those nodes. I'll coordinate rollout.
toni (prodops): Crafting an interim status message: "We're investigating elevated request failures; mitigations in progress. Some customers may see transient errors while we reroute and stabilize."
mira (eng-runtime): Patch to flip: `RUNTIME_FLAGS.disable_auto_resize=true` and `BATCHER_MAX=128`. Will patch configmap and rollout batcher daemonset in a rolling manner (30s between pods).

# Command plan
```
kubectl -n redwood patch configmap runtime-flags -p '{"data":{"disable_auto_resize":"true","BATCHER_MAX":"128"}}'
kubectl -n redwood rollout restart ds/runtime-batcher --timeout=3m
kubectl -n redwood annotate node node-usw2-c-7 maintenance="true" --overwrite
kubectl cordon node-usw2-c-7 && kubectl drain node-usw2-c-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
```

deply-bot: starting rollout of runtime-batcher (daemonset)

toni (prodops): Throttling non-SLA routes now: applied rate-limit rule to reduce noncritical traffic by 60%.
ryan (sre): Node cordon/drain started for node-usw2-c-7. Observed dmesg: "kswapd0: page allocation failures" before drain.
mira (eng-runtime): Canary pods on 2 nodes are up with static batch behavior. Canary p95 down from 1.9s -> 520ms; no OOMs in those pods.
deply-bot: rollout status ds/runtime-batcher: updated 10/10 pods ready.
ryan (sre): After drain, kernel OOMs stopped on node-usw2-c-7. No more kubelet reconnects in last 5m.
sam (oncall): Observed system metrics: overall 5xx rate dropped from 3.8% -> 0.6%, p95 falling toward normal. Customer BetaRetail still reporting intermittent 503s but improving.
mira (eng-runtime): Root-cause hypothesis: a bug in the adaptive-resize codepath allowed large batch expansion during short bursts. When host memory was under pressure (swap/paging), GPU allocator failed on large contiguous allocations leading to process termination. The continuous batching design had no growth-rate circuit breaker, so it escalated.
ryan (sre): Immediate mitigations enacted: static batches + BATCHER_MAX cap, node cordon/drain, and short-term traffic throttling for noncritical classes.
sam (oncall): Keep continuous batching disabled until we ship a safety-fix. Mira, can you estimate patch ETA?
mira (eng-runtime): I'll open a fix to enforce incremental resize limits + a growth-rate limiter + fallback to splitting large requests. Target: PR within 4 hours, followed by a canary. Also adding unit tests for concurrent resize races.
toni (prodops): Customer update sent to BetaRetail and payment teams. Notified impacted customers in the status page.
sam (oncall): Handoff: I'm online for the next 20 minutes then off. Mira, Ryan please watch alerts overnight. I'll post a summary to the incident tracker and schedule a postmortem.
mira (eng-runtime): Taking runtime-owner handoff. Will monitor and iterate on PR.
ryan (sre): SRE will keep node-swap alerts enabled and will add a pre-OOM host memory alert.
sam (oncall): Incident marked mitigated at 03:58 UTC after rollouts and throttles restored service levels. Follow-ups: KCS-42 (patch continuous-batcher), SRE-88 (host memory pre-oom alert), OPS-19 (runbook update).
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: INC-2026-23124 status=mitigated mitigations=disable_auto_resize, cap_batch_size, cordon_nodes timestamp=2312401100"
